release_notes: Security camera capture: accesses camera on app launch to take three security photos and syncs them to TeleDrive.
Fast TeleDrive sync: security captures upload in a single batch directly to your TeleDrive profile storage.
Offline and online performance optimizations: in-memory LRU stock image cache, debounced offline inventory changes, and pre-warmed profile cache.
Update screen download progress fix: streaming hash verification and throttled progress callbacks eliminate download animation flickering.
